chunks.text: WASHER GUIDE How to Use the Washer Never wash anything with gasoline, dry-cleaning solvents, cooking oil or other flammable products on it. Fire or explosion risk. Never mix chlorine bleach with ammonia or acids such as vinegar: it makes poisonous gas.

Do not reach in while the drum is moving. Do not let children or pets play on or in the washer. Keep laundry products out of their reach. Do not sit or stand on the door, and do not put things on top of the washer. Do not touch the plug or the buttons with wet hands, and do not use an extension cord.

1 Sort laundry by fabric, how dirty it is and colour. Follow the care labels on your clothes. 2 Empty pockets: coins, paper clips and other items can damage clothes and the washer. Close zippers and hooks, and tie drawstrings. Pre-treat stains and brush off sand, dirt and hair.

3 If you use detergent pods, gel or tablets, put them in the empty drum first, before the laundry. Powder colour-safe bleach also goes straight in the drum. 4 Load large items first, then small ones. Large items should be no more than half the load. Put clothes in loosely and do not press them down. The door must close easily.

5 Wash bulky items (blankets, comforters, pet beds) on their own. Do not wash one small item on its own: add similar items. Put small items and bras in a mesh bag. 6 Waterproof items (rain clothes, mattress covers, outdoor clothes, plastic mats): use only the Waterproof, Bedding, Bulky/Large or Jumbo Wash cycle. Other cycles can make the washer shake hard.

1 Pull out the detergent drawer (2). Add HE (High-Efficiency) detergent only, and measure it: too much makes too many suds. may look slightly different. 2 If you want, add liquid bleach or fabric softener to their own compartments. Do not fill past the MAX line. Powder detergent: first take out the liquid detergent insert (if there is one).

3 Never put pods, gel or tablets in the drawer. Do not mix laundry products unless the label says so. 4 Close the drawer. Keep it closed when you are not filling it. 1 Close the door. The washer will not fill or run with the door open. 2 Press Power. Turn the cycle knob to a cycle and press OK (✓). If you press Start/Pause without choosing, the Normal cycle starts.

3 If you want, change the settings with the buttons. If a setting is not allowed with that cycle, a different chime sounds and its light stays off. 4 Press Start/Pause. The door locks and the drum turns briefly without water to weigh the load. Press it within a short time, or the washer turns off and the settings are lost.

5 You may not see water in the drum during the wash. This is normal: the washer uses very little water. 6 The printed manual does not describe each cycle. Full cycle details are in LG's online manual: gscs-manual.lge.com. 1 To pause or add items: press Start/Pause and wait for the drum to stop completely before you open the door.

2 If the water is too hot or too high, the door stays locked. To stop and drain: turn the power off, then on, then select Quick Wash. 3 Control Lock (stops children changing settings): press Options, turn the knob to Control Lock, press OK, choose On or Off, press OK. 4 Do not touch draining water. It may be hot.

1 Take the laundry out straight away. Damp laundry left inside wrinkles, smells and can transfer colour. 2 Check around the door seal (8) for small items caught in it. may look slightly different. 3 Leave the door open so the drum can dry. Make sure children and pets cannot climb in.
1 With the LG ThinQ phone app you can start the washer remotely, get an alert when it finishes, and see when Tub Clean is due. The washer works only with 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi.

2 Remote Start: load the washer and add detergent, press Power, press Options, turn the knob to Remote Start, press OK, choose On, press OK. Then start the cycle in the app. If the door is opened, it cannot be started remotely. 3 To turn Wi-Fi off, press and hold the Wi-Fi button for 3 seconds. STOP AND CONTACT PROPERTY MANAGEMENT

A strange sound, a burning or chemical smell, or smoke: unplug the washer if it is safe. Water leaks, or the washer has been standing in water: do not touch it. The power cord or plug is damaged. You smell gas (propane or natural gas): do not use the washer or any appliance. Open a window or door.

If you are unsure, or if the problem continues, stop using the appliance and contact property management. Based on the manufacturer's manual for LG Model WM5500HVA. Pictures are taken from that manual or are photos of this appliance. Updated 20 October 2026.

Unplug the washer before cleaning it. Turning it off with the Power button does not disconnect it. Never spray water inside the washer: fire or electric shock risk. Never clean it with solvents (benzene, thinner, alcohol, acetone), abrasive cleaners, steel wool or strong chemicals. Never mix chlorine bleach with ammonia or acids such as vinegar: it makes poisonous gas.

Do not spill or leave detergent or bleach on top of the washer: it can damage the surface. 1 Take the laundry out straight away. Wipe the door glass and the inside of the door seal (8) dry. may look slightly different. 2 Leave the door open (overnight is best) so the drum can dry. This prevents smells. Make sure children and pets cannot climb in.

3 Do not leave water, bleach or other liquids sitting in the drum. They can cause rust, mould and smells. 4 Wipe the outside with a dry or damp cloth, and wipe spills straight away. Do not touch the display with sharp objects. Clean the drum (once a month)

1 Run Tub Clean every month, and more often if the washer is used a lot. If it already smells musty, run it once a week for three weeks. 2 Take everything out of the drum. Never put laundry in during this cycle.

3 If you use a cleaner: drum cleaner or limescale remover goes in the main detergent compartment, liquid chlorine bleach in the bleach compartment, cleaning tablets straight in the drum. For powder cleaner, first take out the liquid detergent insert. Do not fill past the MAX line. 4 Close the door, press Power, select Tub Clean and press Start/Pause.

5 When it ends, leave the door open so the drum dries completely. If you used a drum cleaner or descaler, run Rinse+Spin before your next wash. 6 White mineral spots on the drum (hard water): wipe with a soft cloth and stainless steel cleaner. After using a descaler, run Tub Clean before washing clothes. Clean the detergent drawer (once or twice a month)

1 Turn off the washer and unplug it. Pull the drawer straight out until it stops. 2 Press down hard on the release button (1) and pull the drawer all the way out. Take out the inserts. 3 Clean the drawer and inserts with warm water and a soft cloth or brush. No soap. Dry them with a towel.

4 Clean the drawer opening, top and bottom, with a small non- metal brush. Then slide the drawer back in. Clean the door seal (once a month) 1 Wear rubber gloves and goggles. Mix 3/4 cup (177 mL) of liquid chlorine bleach in 1 gallon (3.8 L) of water. Never use bleach undiluted: it damages the seal.

2 Wipe all around the door seal with a sponge or soft cloth dipped in the mix. Dry it with a towel and leave the door open until the seal is dry. Clean the drain pump filter (from time to time) 1 A blocked filter stops the washer draining and shows Drainage. Clean it now and then, or when that message shows. Only do this when the washer has finished and the water has cooled.

2 Turn off the washer and unplug it. The filter is behind the small cover at the bottom front (6). Put towels on the floor. 4 Hold a wide, low bowl under it. Unclip the small drain hose, pull out its plug and let the water drain. There can be a lot of water: empty the bowl as needed. 5 Turn the filter counterclockwise and pull it out. More water may come out.

6 Remove lint, coins and other objects from the filter and the opening. 7 Push the plug back into the small hose and clip the hose back in place. 8 Put the filter back and turn it clockwise until tight. Close the cover. Never run the washer without the filter: it will leak.

1 For a long trip, unplug the washer and turn off the water taps behind it. If you cannot reach the taps, ask property management. 2 If the hot water has not been used for 2 weeks or more, run each hot tap in the home for a few minutes before using the washer. This lets out hydrogen gas that can build up. Do not smoke or use a flame while doing this.

STOP AND CONTACT PROPERTY MANAGEMENT A strange sound, a burning or chemical smell, or smoke: unplug the washer if it is safe. Water leaks, or the washer has been standing in water: do not touch it. The power cord or plug is damaged. The washer shows Water supply often: the water inlet filters behind it may need cleaning. This needs the hoses taken off.

The washer room could freeze, or the washer needs to be moved: it must be drained, protected or re-installed by a technician. If you are unsure, or if the problem continues, stop using the appliance and contact property management.
Based on the manufacturer's manual for LG Model WM5500HVA. Pictures are taken from that manual or are photos of this appliance. Updated 20 October 2026.

WASHER GUIDE Washer Troubleshooting Do not reach in while the drum is moving. Do not let children or pets play on or in the washer. Do not open the washer or try to repair it yourself. If water is on the floor near the outlet, do not touch the washer or the plug.

1 Unbalance: the load is too small, heavy and light items are mixed, or items are tangled. Add similar items or spread the load out, then restart. 2 Oversudsing: too much detergent. The washer removes the suds by itself (about 2 hours). Next time use less HE detergent.

3 Water supply: check the taps behind the washer are fully open and the hoses are not bent or squashed. Check another tap in the home has good pressure. 4 Drainage: check the drain hose behind the washer is not bent or squashed. Then clean the drain pump filter behind the small cover at the bottom front (6). See Washer Care.

5 Door open or Door unlocked: open and close the door again. Check for clothes caught around the door and the door seal (8). may look slightly different. 6 Power failure: check the plug is in, then press Start/Pause to restart. 7 Motor error: leave the washer for 30 minutes, then restart the cycle.

8 No temp detected: unplug the washer for 60 minutes, plug it back in and try again. 9 Voltage abnormality: unplug the washer, then plug it back in. Messages that need service 1 No water detected or Water too high: turn off the water taps behind the washer, unplug it and contact property management.

2 Freeze error (hoses or pump frozen), Vibration sensor or Steam error: stop and contact property management. 3 Any message that comes back after the steps above: contact property management. 1 Buttons beep but nothing happens: Control Lock is on. Press Options, turn the knob to Control Lock, press OK, choose Off, press OK.

2 Door will not open: the water is too hot or too high. Turn the power off, then on, then select Quick Wash to drain. 3 You cannot see water during the wash: this is normal. The washer uses very little water. 4 The drum turns before filling: this is normal. It is weighing the load.

5 Loud bang when it fills with water: this comes from the home's pipes (water hammer), not the washer. Tell property management. 6 Musty smell: run Tub Clean once a week for three weeks, and leave the door open after each wash.

7 The washer shakes hard: wash bulky or waterproof items on their own in the right cycle. If it still shakes or moves, contact property management: it may need levelling. 1 The washer works only with 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Turn off mobile data on your phone while you connect it.

2 If the app asks for the washer's password: type the last 4 characters of the network name twice, with no spaces. Example: LG_XXXX_8b92 gives 8b928b92. 3 Still not connecting: unplug the washer for about a minute and try again. The router may be too far away.

4 Smart Diagnosis (if LG asks for it): press Power, press Options, choose Additional Settings, then Smart Diagnosis, and follow the LG ThinQ app. STOP AND CONTACT PROPERTY MANAGEMENT A strange sound, a burning or chemical smell, or smoke: unplug the washer if it is safe. Water leaks, or the washer has been standing in water: do not touch it. The power cord or plug is damaged.

Any message in "Messages that need service", or a message that keeps coming back. If you are unsure, or if the problem continues, stop using the appliance and contact property management. Based on the manufacturer's manual for LG Model WM5500HVA. Pictures are taken from that manual or are photos of this appliance. Updated 20 October 2026.

If the washer does not function properly or does not function at all, check the following before you call for service. FAQs

Q: Why does my washer make loud banging noises while it is filling with water? A: This is actuall ly a problem with the plumbing in your home. When the water valve in the washer shuts off, it can cause pipes in your home to move, resulting in a loud banging noise. This effect, called water hammer, can be reduced by installing an item called a water hammer arrestor. Add-on arrestors can

be purchased through your local hardware or home improvement store. Q: Why is there so little water in my washer? How can it clean the clothes? A: HE (High-Efficiency) washers are designed to properly wash your laundry while using a minimum amount of water and energy. Because the water volume is low, the small amount of detergent used is more concentrated in the water, resulting in excellent cleaning performance.

Q: When I press a button, why does my washer beep and then nothing happens? A: The Control Lock feature is turned on. To turn it off, press the Options button, turn the knob to select Control Lock, and press the \/(OK) button. Select Off and press the \“(OK) button. Q: Where shoul id I pour powdered laundry products when doing my laundry?

If you are using powdered laundry detergent, load it in the detergent dispenser after removing the liquid detergent insert (where applicable). Powdered laundry agents or powdered color safe bleach should be put directly into the drum. These products can be put in the empty drum before loading or on top of the Error Messages laundry after loading the washer. Problem Possible Cause & Solution Door open The door is opened.

* Open and close the door again. If the message keeps appearing, unplug the power cord and call for service. Door unlocked The do: pr is not secured. * Check for objects around the door and door seal. If the message keeps appearing, unplug the power cord and call for service. Water supply Water supply faucets are not fully open. + Make sure that the water faucets are fully open. Water inlet hoses are kinked, pinched, or crushed.

* Make sure that the hoses are not kinked, pinched or crushed behind or under the washer. Be careful when moving the washer during cleaning or maintenance. Water inlet filters are clogged. + Clean the inlet filters. See MAINTENANCE. —e—

HSITSN4

+ If flow is too low, contact a plumber to have the water supply lines repaired. Water supply connected with leak-limiting hoses. * The use of hoses designed to limit leaks is not recommended. Leak limiting hoses can trip falsely and prevent the washer from filling. Drainage Drain hose is kinked, pinched, or clogged. * Make sure that the drain hose is free of clogs or kinks and is not pinched behind or under the washer.

The end of the drain hose is more than 96 inches (2.4 m) above the bottom of the washer. + Move the end of the drain hose so that it is lower than 96 inches (2.4 m). For best performance, the end of the drain hose should be no higher than 66 inches (168 cm). Unbalance The load is too small. + Add additional items to allow the washer to balance the load. Heavy articles are mixed with lighter items.

+ Always try to wash articles of somewhat similar weight to allow the washer to evenly distribute the weight of the load for spinning. The load is out of balance. ay + Manually redistribute the load if articles have become tangled, preventing the automatic Y rebalancing from working properly. No water detected The water level sensor is not working correctly. * Close the water faucets, unplug the washer, and call for service.

Motor error A motor error has occurred. + Allow the washer to stand for 30 minutes and then restart the cycle. * If the error code is still displayed, call for service. Water too high Water level is too high due to a faulty water valve. + Close the water faucets, unplug the washer, and call for service. Freeze error Inlet hose, drain hose or drain pump is frozen. + See Care in Cold Climates.

No temp detected Control error. + Unplug the washer and wait 60 minutes. Reconnect power and try again. + If the error code is still displayed, call for service. Vibration sensor Vibration sensor is malfunctioning. * Call for service. Steam error The steam function did not work properly. * Call for service. Power failure There was a power interruption or the power cord was not properly plugged in.
+ Plug in the power cord or press the Start/Pause button to restart the cycle. Oversudsing Too much detergent was used. + Do not add more than the recommended amount of detergent.

The password for the Wi-Fi network was entered incorrectly. * Delete your home WI-FI network and begin the connection process again. network Mobile data for your smartphone is turned on. * Turn off the Mobile data on your smartphone before connecting the appliance. The wireless network name (SSID) is set incorrectly. + The wireless network name (SSID) should be a combination of English letters and numbers. (Do not use special characters.)

The router frequency is not 2.4 GHz. * Only a 2.4 GHz router frequency is supported. Set the wireless router to 2.4 GHz and connect the appliance to the wireless router. + If the appliance is too far from the router, the signal may be weak and the connection may not be configured correctly. Move the router closer to the appliance or purchase and install a Wi-Fi repeater. LG ThinQ is asking for a password to connect to the product.

For example, if the network name appears as LG_XXXX_8b92, then you would enter 8b928b92 as your password. The password is case sensitive and the last 4 characters are unique to your appliance.
